input.brief: FAST Saudi industrial engineering: one building reveals its cooling, power, fabrication and intelligent manufacturing systems in a continuous 3D guided tour

direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Sentence with a photo strip
hero.blueprint: A warm flat ground with no navigation bar. One sentence of four or five words runs as a single line of condensed capitals at clamp(120px, 13vw, 200px), sitting on the vertical centre and reaching edge to edge inside 28px margins. Where one word of the sentence would be, a strip of photograph takes its place: a frame exactly one cap-height tall (set in em) and 45–50% of the viewport wide, ratio near 5:1, corners radiused 14px, `object-fit: cover`. Build the line as a flex row with `align-items: baseline` and give the strip `flex: 1` so words and picture always fill the width. The photograph shows the thing the sentence names: a wide view of the place, taken from above or along a horizon, so it survives the letterbox crop. The top third of the screen is empty apart from a 15px wordmark top-left and two text links top-right. About 150px under the sentence the single action sits centred as a small solid button. One supporting sentence at 22px, max 44ch, is centred 48px above the bottom edge.
hero.mobile: The sentence breaks into two lines at 21vw with the strip between them: the first words, then the photograph as a 2:1 frame at full width minus 16px margins with the same 14px corners, then the remaining words. The block is centred vertically. The action button sits 32px under the last line and the supporting sentence under that at 16px. The top links collapse to one word.
hero.headline: A sentence of four or five short words, about 14 characters of type in total, whose missing word is the photograph.

photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Right-half paragraph, lone photo
sections.blueprint: No heading. On a 12-column grid with 5vw margins, one statement paragraph of 45–70 words occupies columns 7–12 only, set at clamp(24px, 2.2vw, 34px) with leading 1.25 and a first-line indent of 3em. Its top edge sits 18vh below the section top. Columns 1–6 stay empty except for a single square photograph, 20vw wide, in columns 1–3, placed so its top aligns with the paragraph's last line and it hangs below the text by most of its height. A five-line note at 14px, 180px wide, sits in columns 1–2, 96px beneath the photograph. Section padding is 160px top and bottom. Nothing is centred: the paragraph's left edge is the midpoint of the page, and later text blocks on the page may reuse that line. Holds one paragraph, one photograph and one note.
sections.mobile: The paragraph comes first at 22px, full width with 20px margins and no indent. The photograph follows at 62% width, pushed to the right margin, in a 4:5 crop instead of square. The small note sits to its left, bottom-aligned with the photograph, in the remaining 30% of the width.

references.name: Seasats
references.idea: Calm, dusk-lit seascapes sell autonomous boats as serene instruments, and the navigation is a column of stacked colour swatches taken from that sea-and-sand palette.
references.hero: A 10px white frame surrounds everything. The left 84% is one rounded media panel: a dusk scene of a low, solar-decked vessel centred on mirror-flat water, with two larger hulls cropped by the panel's left and right edges. The headline is centred in the panel's upper third, two lines of white light-weight flared serif at 124px (8.6vw). A wordmark in custom wide techno lettering sits top-left; a white rounded button with mono caps and a dark-green square arrow sits bottom-centre. The right 14% is the menu: a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks (blush, sage, then four darkening olives), each holding left-aligned 15px links, sub-items numbered 01 to 04.
references.type: seasonMix, a low-contrast serif-sans hybrid, light weight, sentence case, near-zero tracking, at 124px for the headline and about 40px for statements; seasonSans 16px for body and menu; supplyMono uppercase at 9 to 12px for buttons, tags and footer data.
references.colour: #a6b3bc #232323 #b7c8be #d6c4b8 #2c3620 #e2832a — Slate blues and lilac greys from the seascapes dominate; the menu adds blush, sage and olive blocks; the footer flips to a burnt-orange and rust scene. Text stays white.
references.imagery: Photoreal rendered footage of autonomous boats on glassy water at dusk: symmetrical, low horizon, lots of sky, full-bleed after the hero. Small square-cornered inset stills with mono tag labels float over the scene.
references.layout: Mostly full-viewport scenes with one centred text block each, at top or bottom, and the wordmark fixed top-left. Only the hero uses the framed panel-plus-menu split. A thin vertical progress line runs down the right edge.

sections.description: A pinned full-bleed scene shot from the boat's deck: the hull forms a dark symmetrical wedge rising from the bottom edge to a mast at centre, horizon at one-third. At top-centre six short statements are stacked, centred, at 16px; one is white and the others half opacity, and the highlight steps down the list on scroll. For each, small photo cards (150 to 220px wide, square corners, mono tag on the top edge) appear left and right of the mast.

A full-bleed aerial view of dark teal water with several small vessels scattered across the lower half and a faint horizon near the top. A single two-line statement in the light serif at about 40px sits centred near the bottom edge. Nothing else is on screen except the wordmark top-left and the thin progress line at right.

Colour inverts to a burnt-orange haze over rust-red terrain, with black silhouettes of hulls and a keel hanging from the top edge as if seen from below the surface. Mid-height: mono readouts at left reporting distance scrolled in metres and scroll speed in knots with a one-line quip; a link list at 16px in the centre; mono contact details at right. The wordmark fills the full width at the bottom, white, about 130px tall.

steal: Build the menu as a full-height column of stacked flat colour blocks sampled from the imagery, grouping links by block colour instead of by rules or headings.
List every claim at once, centred and dimmed, and move a single full-opacity highlight through the list on scroll while supporting images appear around a fixed subject.
Give the footer its own opposite-temperature scene and a live readout of how far and how fast the visitor scrolled, in the product's own units.

references.name: IZANAMI
references.idea: Silence as design: one small sentence in fog, then a slow descent from mist into a dark glass pavilion.
references.hero: After a warm-black loader showing only one 18px serif sentence and a small counter, the hero is a full-bleed, desaturated grey-green image of pine forest dissolving into fog. The same sentence stays at 18px in white, left-aligned on a line about 17% from the left edge and exactly at vertical centre; it is the only text in the picture area. A small white seal-style logo sits top-left; a language switch and menu label in tiny tracked capitals sit top-right, each with a dot above. Along the bottom edge: copyright, two live city clocks, and a scroll cue at far right, all near 10px.
references.type: Playfair Display regular for the few headings, only 18 to 45px (3.1vw at most); Shippori Mincho for body at 14px; Cinzel capitals with wide tracking for nav, clocks and footer. Nothing is large: hierarchy comes from isolation rather than size.
references.colour: #0a0801 #6f7a70 #b7b5a6 #d9d2c3 #4b5b39 — Warm near-black panels and grey-green fog imagery with off-white text at reduced opacity. Moss green and sand from the small garden photos are the only colour; there is no accent.
references.imagery: Fog-bound forest, a black-framed glass pavilion seen in one-point perspective, and small crops of incense smoke, a bamboo water spout and raked gravel. Small images are square-cornered, portrait or square, overlapping one another and the dark ceiling plane.
references.layout: Wide margins, with text hung on an inner line about 17% across instead of the page edge. Most screens hold one image and one short text; small photos are placed asymmetrically near corners and overlap. A rotated section label runs down the left edge.

sections.description: Over the black ceiling of the pavilion image, a three-line serif heading at about 3vw sits left of centre, each line indented further than the one above. Faint body text follows below it. A small square photo sits top-left under the logo; at right, three portrait photos overlap in a cluster, two beige garden shots behind and a narrower green water-ripple image in front and raised higher, running off the bottom edge.

Full-bleed one-point-perspective view down a glass corridor, its ceiling filling the upper half as near-black. A text link with a short leading rule sits top-left on the inner line; a landscape photo of raked gravel is tucked against the top edge right of centre; a three-line heading fades in low and left of centre over the glass. A section name rotated ninety degrees runs down the far left.

Near-black and almost empty. One section name in serif at about 24px, preceded by a long thin rule, sits at mid-height left of centre. Lower down, tiny tracked-capital columns: a nav list, two office addresses side by side, and social links pushed to the far right. The bottom edge repeats the copyright and the two city clocks.

steal: Place a single 18px sentence at vertical centre on an offset left line over full-bleed fog, and let the absence of a headline be the statement.
Stair-step a three-line heading by indenting each line further than the one above it.
Run two live city clocks with time-zone labels along the bottom edge as quiet proof of where the firm operates.

references.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
references.idea: Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.
references.hero: A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.
references.type: Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.
references.imagery: Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.
references.layout: 24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.

sections.description: White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.

Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.

A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.

Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.

steal: Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.
Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.
Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.
